West Northamptonshire Council

Dormers, Chimneys and Billing Road

West Northamptonshire Council looks after 117 conservation areas, and in Northampton they include Billing Road, Kingsley, Abington Park, Barrack Road, Kingsthorpe and Duston.

Inside any of them, the council says, a roof extension or dormer window needs planning permission, as does a chimney, flue or soil and vent pipe on a roof slope facing a road, and solar panels standing more than 20cm proud of the roof.

Article 4 Directions can bring even small jobs like re-roofing under planning control. Billing Road's, made on 15 March 2013, covers changes to a roof slope facing a road or open space, and putting in, altering or replacing a chimney.

Source: West Northamptonshire Council: conservation areas, Heritage Article 4s, Billing Road Article 4 Direction

SuperFOIL Insulation

SF19 and SF40, Fitted to Spec

SuperFOIL only performs when it's fitted the way the maker says, with the right air gaps, ventilation, sealed joints and overlaps.

We fit SF19 and SF40, and we look at the whole roof structure first so the right product goes in. Being roofers helps, because the foil has to work with the roof it is fixed to. Most jobs take 1 to 3 working days.
